newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to raise margins on cocoa futures June 24.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to raise margins on cocoa futures June 24.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said Monday it will raise margins on the July 1997 and September 1997 cocoa contracts by $200 to $800, including no spot charge, effective June 24.
The margin on all other coffee contracts will also be increased by $200, to $800, the exchange said in a statement.
The change comes less than a week after the exchange raised cocoa margins by $100, to $600.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
